dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea : Cultural Places (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Cultural and historic places from OSM. Includes museums, galleries, theatres, places of worship, monuments, and historic sites tagged via `tourism`, `amenity`, `historic`, or `heritage`. Useful for heritage protection, cultural mapping, and tourism context. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:tourism](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tourism), [Key:amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [Key:historic](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:historic), [Key:heritage](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:heritage) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
